national.o: Single emergency number for police, fire and ambulance. Women Helpline 181 and Child Helpline 1098 are linked to it, so calls can be transferred.

national.n: Women Helpline (Ministry of Women and Child Development)
national.o: Toll-free. Refers women to police, hospitals, legal aid and One Stop Centres, and gives information on government schemes. Integrated with 112.

national.n: National Commission for Women (NCW) Women Helpline
national.o: For women and girls above 18. Trained counsellors register complaints and refer to police, hospitals, legal services and One Stop Centres. For an emergency call 112.

national.n: National Commission for Women: online complaint
national.o: Register a complaint online: domestic violence, dowry, harassment, rape, police refusing to register an FIR, sexual harassment at work, and more.
Toll-free free legal aid: speak to a panel lawyer. Women are entitled to free legal services regardless of income. Hindi and English.

national.n: National Cyber Crime Helpline and Reporting Portal
national.o: Report online harassment, stalking, morphed images, sextortion and financial fraud. The portal has a special focus on cyber crimes against women and children and allows anonymous reporting of sexual content involving children.
For any child (under 18) in need of care and protection, including girls facing abuse or child marriage. Linked to 112 for emergencies.
Online complaint for sexual harassment at the workplace, for women in any job, organised or unorganised, public or private. The complaint goes to the authority responsible.
Free counselling by phone in 20 languages (Ministry of Health and Family Welfare).
Security help for passengers in distress on trains and at stations; linked to 112. RPF "Meri Saheli" teams look after women travelling alone.

national.n: iCALL Psychosocial Helpline (Tata Institute of Social Sciences)
national.o: Free telephone and email counselling by trained mental health professionals for anyone in emotional or psychological distress, across age, language, gender and sexual orientation. Anonymous. Email replies within 24 hours. Not an emergency service.
Free mental health counselling and crisis support by trained counsellors, private and confidential. The site says you can call or WhatsApp from anywhere in India at any hour.

national.a: 104, Sunrise Arcade, Plot No. 100, Sector 16, Koparkhairane, Navi Mumbai - 400709
national.o: Crisis intervention helpline for emotional crisis, mental illness and suicidal thoughts, staffed by trained volunteers. General emotional support, not specific to violence against women. 022-27546667 is listed as the office quick contact.

national.n: Jan Sahas Helpline for Girls and Women
national.o: Toll-free helpline for girls and women facing any kind of violence. Jan Sahas works with survivors of sexual violence and runs related helplines for shelter and counselling support.

Anti-human-trafficking organisation that works with police to rescue trafficked women and children. Also runs the India Cyber Tip Helpline for reporting online child sexual abuse material (report form on the site, or email cybertiphelpline@shaktivahini.net).

state.o: State police wing overseeing SHE Teams, Bharosa centres, DV module, NRI cell, anti-human-trafficking and cyber cell for women. For emergencies dial 100 (or 1098 for children); the contact form is not for emergencies.

state.n: SHE Teams, Telangana Police Women Safety Wing
state.o: 331 SHE Teams across Telangana handle street sexual harassment, harassment in public places, stalking, online/phone harassment. Report by Dial 100, WhatsApp or the nearest police station.

state.n: Bharosa Support Centres for Women & Children, Telangana Police
state.o: For rape/attempt to rape, sexual assault and child sexual abuse: police, medical, legal, prosecution support and psychological counselling in one place away from police stations. Being replicated in all districts.

state.n: Domestic Violence Module, Telangana Police Women Safety Wing
state.o: Handles domestic violence and dowry harassment complaints (physical, verbal, emotional, sexual, economic abuse).

state.n: NRI Cell for Women, Telangana Police Women Safety Wing
state.o: For women facing domestic violence/harassment by NRI husbands, desertion abroad, and marriage fraud.
Journey monitoring for women: dial 100 and press 8 in the IVR to start tracking, or use the T-Safe app (Android/iOS). Deviation or no response triggers a Dial 100 response.
